subject.title: feat: add /mark command for session label presets

question: Should preset session marks become a permanent core slash command and persisted session contract, or should this capability live in a plugin with any missing generic session-label API added first?
rationale: VISION.md favors plugins for optional capabilities, while accepting this branch would commit core to preset policy, localization behavior, and a new persisted session field.

options.title: Route through a plugin API
options.body: Keep core lean by implementing `/mark` as a ClawHub plugin and add only a generic session-label mutation seam if the current SDK cannot express it safely.

options.title: Sponsor the core command
options.body: Explicitly accept the preset and persistence contract, then require provenance-safe labels, focused compatibility coverage, accurate preset-source documentation, and real runtime proof before merge.

recommendation.title: Route through a plugin API
recommendation.body: Keep core lean by implementing `/mark` as a ClawHub plugin and add only a generic session-label mutation seam if the current SDK cannot express it safely.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent work connects this contributor most closely to agent-session state and runtime contract behavior among the available history signals.
